articleTitle: Characterization of indoor penetration loss at ISM band
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The potential implementation of wireless radio local area networks and personal communication services inside buildings requires a thorough understanding of signal propagation in a building. In this paper in-building penetration loss measurements, at 2.4 GHz. (the ISM band) have been presented for materials used in indoor environments. To obtain the data, measurements were performed at 160 MHz bandwidth centered on 2.4 GHz using a vector network analyzer. These measurements may aid in the development of future in-building wireless networks in this band.

articleTitle: Analysis and simulation of Nakagami fading channel with MATLAB
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The paper simulated and analyzed the statistical performance of the Nakagami fading channel in wireless communication with MATLAB, including the complex envelop of the received signal, the level crossing rates and average fade durations on the maximal-ratio combining diversity.

articleTitle: Synthesis of nonuniformly spaced arrays using genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In many engineering situations, nonuniformly spaced arrays are necessary or useful due to feed network structures, actual system constraints and so on. Other than many conventional synthesis methods, the genetic algorithm (GA) can be used to synthesize such arrays to reach the requirement of the sidelobe level. The optimized variables in the nonuniformly spaced array are usually chosen as the element positions. In the application of digital beamforming antenna systems, the optimized variables may be chosen as element positions, amplitudes, phases or some combination of them, which provide more degrees of freedom to the synthesis of arrays than before. Simulation results show that this method is valuable.

articleTitle: Measurement of electromagnetic properties of materials using transmission/reflection method in coaxial line
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Transmission/reflection frequency-domain measurements to determine the electromagnetic properties of solid materials in a coaxial line are introduced in this essay. The method can determine both the complex relative permittivity (/spl epsiv//sub r/) and permeability (/spl mu//sub r/) simultaneously. A few problems such as half-wavelength divergence, phase jump, multiplicity of roots etc. have been discussed. As sample materials, the derived /spl epsiv//sub r/ and /spl mu//sub r/ of teflon and some absorbers are given and the accuracy of the test system is described. The advantage of this system is to determine the electromagnetic properties of absorptive materials.

articleTitle: Complexity feature extraction of radar emitter signals
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Because the intra-pulse modulation laws of radar emitter signals reflect directly on the signal waveform, a novel approach is presented to extract the complexity features (CFs) of radar emitter signals. CFs, including Lempel-Ziv complexity (LZC) and correlation dimension (CD), can measure the complexity and irregularity of radar signals effectively. To show the effectiveness and feasibility of the introduced approach, CFs of 10 typical radar emitter signals are extracted in our experiments. The results demonstrate that the CFs have good characteristics for clustering the same radar signals and separating different radar signals, which indicates that CF can simplify the design procedure of classifiers and greatly heighten the identification accuracy rate of radar emitter signals.

articleTitle: Research on absorbing properties of the concrete shielding material at 3mm wave bands
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The concrete was made from standard sand, steel fiber, iron ore-sand, carbon-fiber felt, ZnO whisker, ferrite, acetylene gas black, carbonyl iron, so that the concrete shielding material has the microwave absorbing performance. The aim is to search for a new protection method for grand buildings and martial building constructions. The concrete shielding material is first analyzed in the 3mm waveband. The paper focuses on the different absorption characteristic of concrete with different material and different content. The relation of content is discussed. It is guide for the future research.

articleTitle: Analysis of resonance characteristics of a power bus with rectangle and triangle elements in multilayer PCBs
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: One of the major sources of radiated EMI is attributed to power bus resonance in a printed circuit board (PCB). A fast algorithm, combined with the segmentation method, is applied for calculating resonance characteristics of a power bus whose pattern consists of several segments of rectangles and/or right-angled triangles. Good agreement between the calculated and measured results demonstrates the usefulness and accuracy of the fast algorithm and the segmentation method.

articleTitle: On passive intermodulation at microwave frequencies
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The appearance of PIM products bring a lot of harm into modern satellite communication systems. In this paper, the fundamental concept, mechanism and prediction of PIM are studied. And one mathematical model is given, which is able to predict high order PIM level by using low order PIM level.

articleTitle: Analysis of shielding effectiveness of reinforced-concrete in high power electromagnetic environment
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The finite-difference time domain (FDTD) method is used to analyze shielding effectiveness of the infinite wire-mesh reinforcement, reinforced-concrete layer and concrete-only layer in a high power electromagnetic environment. Our research takes into account all the factors affecting shielding effectiveness (jointing of reinforcing steels' cross points, connection of the reinforcement hoops and natural defensive layers). Numerical examples concerning the analysis are given in this paper.

articleTitle: Analysis of crosstalk of coupled transmission lines by inserting additional traces grounded with vias on printed circuit boards
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In analog and digital electronic systems, crosstalk between traces on the printed circuit boards (PCB) can degrade the performance of equipment operations. To reduce crosstalk between two parallel traces of which one is called aggressor trace and the other one is called victim trace, two additional traces grounded by vias are inserted and the aggressor trace is in between the grounded traces. To deal with the complex structure this paper presents a simple equivalent model to simulate the discontinuity caused by vias and the crosstalk is solved by using multiconductor transmission lines theory. The simulation results indicate the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Simulation for crosstalk in coupled microstrip transmission lines
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In high-speed PCB design, parallel microstrip transmission lines are common, in which a serious crosstalk problem usually arises when dealt with incorrectly. In this paper, based on the mode of two parallel microstrip transmission lines, we discussed the crosstalk problem with coupled transmission lines theory. Then, the crosstalk problems under several circumstances are simulated, so as to analyze the influence of the crosstalk in different conditions. Finally, some methods of restraining crosstalk have been summarized to provide some qualitative advices for PCB design.

articleTitle: Identification of ULF emissions for Izu islands earthquakes in July 2000
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The purpose of this report is to find out any ULF signature for the earthquakes in Izu islands in July 2000 (associated with volcanic activity) by means of a new signal processing method. The ULF data observed at three closely spaced stations in Izu peninsula, are subjected to the principal component analysis (PCA), and we have found that this PCA is very effective in distinguishing among different sources of ULF emissions (geomagnetic variation, man-made noise, and seismogenic emission). While, the first and second principal components are found to be associated with geomagnetic variation and man-made activity, respectively, the third principal component (residual noise like seismogenic emission if it exists) at night has indicated a significant temporal evolution; an enhancement for about 1.5 months (from early May to middle June) and a conspicuous minimum about ten days before the first earthquake on July 1 (magnitude 6.4), followed by a sharp increase a few days before the earthquakes. Furthermore, this component is found to be back to the background level a few months later than the earthquakes. This temporal pattern is in good agreement with those for previous large earthquake (Spitak, Loma Prieta, Guam and Biak earthquakes), so that this temporal evolution for the third principal component found by PCA is likely to be a precursory ULF signature of those Izu islands' earthquakes with its intensity of the order of 5% of the first principal component.

articleTitle: Analysis of transient grounding resistance under pulsed discharging current
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper presents numerical analysis of the transient grounding resistance of the grounding conductor under pulsed discharging current using the FDTD method; and analyses the influence of its size, buried depth and the ground conductivity. In the end, methods for reducing transient grounding resistance and discharging faster are discussed.

articleTitle: The definition of EMP shielding effectiveness
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper the experimental results of the interference and damage effects of plane-wave EMP and pulsed magnetic field on microcomputer and microcomputer measuring and control apparatus are introduced. Then some important conclusions are obtained, and, on this basis, the author presents the definition of EMP shielding effectiveness.

articleTitle: A novel measurement system for substation grounding resistance
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: A measurement system including a notebook PC for substation grounding resistance has been developed. The measurement method is based on short lead wire of current electrode and a frequency inverter AC source with relatively low power. Results of computation and measurement based on this novel method and the traditional method are presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the measurement system.

articleTitle: Via design in multi-layer PCB
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Vias between routing layers induce interconnection discontinuities. Signal reflection on the track is enhanced because of these discontinuities. A via is a noise source as the signal frequency increases. The reflection fraction changes with the via geometry properties, especially via height. The paper focuses on the influence of via height on signal reflection. Via heights from 250 /spl mu/m to 1500 /spl mu/m are studied under high frequency by simulation. The reflection loss caused by a via increases with via height nonlinearly. Considering the reflection, an optimization criterion for via design is provided.

articleTitle: FDTD calculation of organ resonance characteristics in an anatomically based human model for plane-wave exposure
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: It is well known that electromagnetic (EM) energy is absorbed inhomogeneously in the human body even for plane-wave exposure. This implies that local resonance for various individual organs may occur. In order to investigate this implication, we analyzed numerically the organ resonance characteristics in the frequency range from 30 MHz up to 3 GHz with an anatomically based high-precision human body model and a parallel finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) technique. As a result, we found that the whole-body resonance occurring around 65 MHz causes the local resonance for all the organs at the same frequency. Local resonance peculiar to each of organs was also found to occur around 900 GHz for the brain, eyes and heart, 600 MHz for the testicles, and so on.

articleTitle: Influence of power system's harmonic voltage on leakage current of MOA
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Surge arresters are important over voltage protection equipment in a substation. It is necessary to monitor the resistive leakage current of MOAs (metal oxide surge arresters) on line so that we can prevent faults from developing in time to avoid economic loss. It is reasonable to adopt the resistive leakage currents basic component, i/sub r/, and thrice component, i/sub 3r/, as metal oxide surge arrester indicators. These indicators can detect the aging phenomenon of a metal oxide surge arrester in time. However, the existence of harmonic voltages in the power system influences the indicator accuracy. We analyze this effect and put forward an improved compensation method to separate the resistive leakage current under the existence of harmonic voltage. Finally, according to these methods, we develop an on-line MOA resistive current monitoring system based on the bus-module.

articleTitle: Common-mode inductance and radiation of edge placed differential traces on printed circuited board
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: With respect to the single-ended trace (track), differential signaling is most advantageous to signal integrity and common-mode radiation level reduction. However, to guarantee the required signal transmission, the two tracks in the differential pair should be perfectly balanced. Edged placement of a differential pair on the PCB causes balance disruption and creates common-mode (CM) currents resulting in an increased electromagnetic interference level. We quantify the CM inductance and radiation from differential tracks with edge placement. The common-mode inductance of an edged-placed differential pair on a PCB is derived. Then the characteristics of the common-mode inductance of a differential pair are studied for different geometries. Finally, the total radiation powers for several geometries due to the edge placement of the differential pair are measured.

articleTitle: The electromagnetic field of a time-harmonic HED embedded in an n-layer conducting half-space
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: A series of general expressions of the electromagnetic field in the first layer of a stratified half-space composed of n linear homogeneous conducting layers, produced by a time-harmonic HED which is embedded in the same first conducting layer, is presented by applying the Hankel transform and the inverse Hankel transform. The questions of electromagnetic field in a stratified conducting half-space which includes any number of conducting layers can be easily solved by means of these expressions.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the EMP shielding effectiveness for the thin metallic shells
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: It is essential for many EMC problems to evaluate the transient shielding effectiveness of thin metallic shells. A fast time domain approach is presented to calculate the transient shielding effectiveness of the thin metallic shells excited by an arbitrary waveform electromagnetic pulse. The frequency domain transfer function of the thin metallic shell is fitted into the rational function by the vector fitting method, and the pulse response can be expressed by a sum of decay exponentials in the time domain by the inverse Laplace transformation. The transient shielding effectiveness excited by an arbitrary waveform can be obtained easily based on the recursive convolution formulation. The advantage of the proposed method lies in two aspects. It is a time domain algorithm without needing the time-consuming FFT approach, and the scheme of recursive convolution can improve the calculation efficiency dramatically. The proposed approach is validated by some numerical examples.

articleTitle: Analysis of mirror frequency rejection in quadrature coherent detectors via interpolation method
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The basic principles of quadrature coherent detectors via the interpolation method are described in this paper. Signal flow being analyzed, the rejection of mirror frequencies is discussed, based on computer simulation. Both the theoretical analysis and simulation make good reference to engineering applications.

articleTitle: The calculation of the 3D-electromagnetic fields in GIS using the numerical electromagnetic code
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Methods for the modeling and calculation of radiant interference in GIS are discussed. A radiant thin wire model of a domestic GIS is set up and the 3D-electromagnetic fields in this substation are computed by means of the numerical electromagnetic code (NEC). A method to minimize the calculation error using the NEC thin wire model is proposed.

articleTitle: Evaluation of hair displacement in ELF electric field exposure
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: For the study of the biological effects of ELF electric fields, the displacement of a hair exposed in the field was evaluated. In a theoretical study, the formulas for the electric force and the displacement were obtained. It was demonstrated that a 450 kV/m field can move a hair an observable amount.

articleTitle: Design and performance of TEM horn antenna with low-frequency compensation
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: By adding a loop to an exponentially flared TEM horn and properly adjusting the loop structure, a TEM horn antenna with low-frequency compensation is designed. The added loop structure, together with the horn arms, provide an equivalent magnetic-dipole moment at low frequency to combine with the electric-dipole moment formed between the two arms of the TEM horn. The low-frequency radiation can be enhanced effectively when the two moments meet the balance condition. The performance of the designed TEM horn antenna, including the radiated field strengths on and off the boresight direction, the front-to-back ratio, the reflection from inside of the horn, and the field distribution on the horn aperture, is studied and compared to an ordinary TEM horn by using FDTD simulation. The TEM horn with low-frequency compensation provides higher radiation efficiency and broader beamwidth if compared to an ordinary TEM horn antenna.

articleTitle: Coupling issues between two signal lines at split ground planes
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Based on the transmission line model and mode conversion theory, this paper discusses unwanted noise coupling between two signal lines that cross the same ground slot. It is also demonstrated how some physical parameters affect the coupling performance of the pair of signal lines. Design rules for choosing proper parameters for isolated ground islands in a mixed-signal environment are also discussed.

articleTitle: The effect of added electric charge in rice seeds on the rice growth
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper presents the effect of added electric charge in rice seed on the rice growth operating under humidity and temperature control. The parameters to evaluate the rice seed are the germination index, percent germination and elongated radical. The experimental results by adding electric charge in rice seed, give higher of the rice growth than of that conventional method by about 5-10 % in the laboratory and result in the increasing of rice production by 10-40 % in weight/area of rice field.

articleTitle: The study of rice growing with the electromagnetic field effect simulated from 300 kV switching substation
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, the effect of an electric field on the growth of rice plants is studied. The research is focused on an electric field. The comparison is done under the conditions with electric field at 28.5 kV/m and without electric field. The rice plants are experimented with under the condition of the electric field. Rice is laid transversely and horizontally, respectively. The results with the electric field are compared to those without electric field. It is found that the rice plant growth with electric field has a high growth rate of the height of stems and the length of roots more so than in the case without the electric field.

articleTitle: The analysis of frequency-hopping signal acquisition based on Cohen-reassignment joint time-frequency distribution
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The optimal kernel distribution of Cohen class time-frequency distribution (TFD) was analyzed, and a method of time-frequency correlation based on Cohen-reassignment TFD was proposed. The analysis method could depict a frequency-hopping signal efficiently and had higher resolution on the time-frequency domain, and could reduce or completely remove the cross-terms and diffuse other signal components. The computation could adopt a module algorithm with lower computation complexity, so it could be used for rapid tracking and acquisition of frequency-hopping communication systems. Computer simulation was also presented to show the performance of the analysis method.

articleTitle: Analysis on shielding effectiveness of metallic enclosures with slot
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The FDTD method is used to study how shielding effectiveness varies with slot length, width and cavity size. The results show that slot resonance occurs when a slot perimeter reaches odd times of the wavelength of the incident wave and the shielding effectiveness becomes rather poor in such cases.

articleTitle: Measurement and analysis of switching transients in 500 kV substations
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In high voltage substations, secondary equipment placed in the switchyard and inside the control house can be highly sensitive to transient electromagnetic disturbances due to switching operations. In order to evaluate transient electromagnetic environments (EME) and provide guidance for better immunity design of secondary equipment, it is necessary to measure and analyze these transient electromagnetic disturbances. While three new 500 kV substations were powered on, many transient electromagnetic disturbances were measured and recorded. Based on the FFT, an analysis program was developed and used to analyze characteristics of the disturbances. The results are summarized. Comparisons with IEC61000-4 series standards are made and recommendations are given.

articleTitle: The shielding effectiveness of steel enclosure for pulsed magnetic field
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: By global analysis of the generator, the loop antenna and the shielding enclosure with the FDTD method, the small-loop approach for measurement of the magnetic field shielding effectiveness was simulated numerically in this paper. Nonuniform meshes and reduced c FDTD method were adopted to solve the contradiction of selecting space step and time step: this makes it possible to calculate the steel shielding efficiency of large dimension. The interaction of shielding enclosure and loop antenna was modeled. The setup of the simulation coincides with the real conditions of engineering testing. The conclusions from the numerical calculation are: the waveform of EMP transparent though the steel shielding enclosure is greatly different from the incident EMP waveform. The rise time changes to be very slow and the width of pulse gets long. The calculating and real testing indicate that the shielding efficiency of the steel enclosure to the EMP with longer rise time (/spl mu/s) and wider duration (1ms) is only about 40 dB, the rise time of transparent pulsed magnetic field reaches ms and the pulse width is more than 10ms. The shielding efficiency of the steel enclosure to low frequency electromagnetic field is much lower.

articleTitle: FDTD evaluation of transmission characteristic in GTEM cells
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The finite difference time domain (FDTD) technique is used to analyze the transmission characteristic in GTEM cells in a polar coordinate system. To simulate the propagation of the wave at the terminal section a first order absorption boundary condition was implemented. The scattering coefficient and characteristic impedance are calculated. The analysis has been carried out in the frequency domain response with pulse source by means of a discrete Fourier transform.

articleTitle: Practical measurement procedure for EM radiation from base stations in Taiwan
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Although there are some international or national standards which recommend measurement method of electromagnetic fields for safety purposes, few of them provide a detailed measurement procedure specifically for base stations. Therefore, we propose a practical measurement procedure to the Environment Protection Agency (EPA) in Taiwan for measuring electromagnetic radiation from AM, FM, TV and mobile telephone base stations. In this paper, we present the new proposed measurement method, which is suitable for most of the practical situations.

articleTitle: The comparison of electric field intensity effects to the bean sprouts growing
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The electric field intensity is varied at 10, 20, 25 kV/m. This paper is focused on the height of stems and the length of roots. The effect of electric field intensity is evaluated on bean sprout growing. The electric field intensity is analyzed by the finite element method. Experimental results indicate that the bean sprout in high electric field intensity has a better growth in comparison with that of low electric field based on statistical analysis.

articleTitle: Research for the radiated emission test
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper analyses the radiated EMI measurements at an OATS, and presents two new methods to resolve the relative problems, the theory of measurement certainty and the theory of imbalance.

articleTitle: Improving the security performance in mobile wireless computing network using smart directional antenna
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The paper discusses the security issues of the infrastructured wireless network and the ad-hoc wireless network using smart directional antennas, and introduces two newly developed smart directional antennas, DE-ESPAR (dielectric embedded electronically steerable parasitic array radiator) and DE-ESMB (dielectric embedded electronically steerable multiple beam) antenna arrays, and their unique performance in improving security performance in a mobile wireless computing network. The further development of the security system using such smart directional antennas in WLAN is also proposed.

articleTitle: A study on the recognizability of information from computer in the electromagnetic leakage
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: There are very complex circuits and various clock signals in a computer. Every component can radiate electromagnetic waves when it works. Some of these radiations may result in computer information leakage. The technology for recognising information leakage caused by video signal electromagnetic radiation is presented, and the primary word image is obtained. So as to get intact useful information from the video signal concealed in the electromagnetic leakage, a pattern recognition method based on an artificial neural network is proposed. Lastly, the primary word image, recovered from the electromagnetic leakage, is recognized and reconstructed. The recognizability of the information leakage from a computer is discussed.

articleTitle: Probe-fed multi-band microstrip single-patch antennas
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The property of multi-band operation has been studied and investigated analytically through the design of a number of rectangular patch microstrip antennas. Two techniques for introducing multi-band operation are adopted in this paper. They are: the probe-fed square patch antenna with three shorting pins at one of the patch's radiating edges, and the probe-fed rectangular patch antenna with different numbers of wide slots arranged at both of the radiating edges. It is shown with the first technique, the patch can resonate at three different frequencies of 1.83 GHz, 2.16 GHz and 2.74 GHz with adequate radiation characteristics to meet the requirements of wireless communication systems. It is also shown that with the second technique, a patch with three slots has a multi-band feature with four resonant frequencies at 1.6 GHz, 1.8 GHz, 2.65 GHz, and 4.83 GHz and adequate values of return loss and gain.

articleTitle: The coupling between the spatial electromagnetic wave and transmission line on PCB
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The reciprocity theorem of antenna is introduced in this paper in researching the coupling between the spatial electromagnetic wave and transmission line on PCB; the complex calculation of the scattering field is avoided. The coupling voltage of the loads is studied in this paper with spatial EM wave incidence upon a transmission line on PCB.

articleTitle: The methods applied to eliminate self-oscillation of one integrated LNA
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: After the reasons for self-oscillation are analyzed, several self-oscillation elimination methods are introduced to the design of a low noise amplifier (LNA) which works in the LS-band. These methods include: adding a source negative feedback stability circuit; improving the decoupling circuit; applying change to the DC power to adjust the static operating point slightly to deal with circuit mismatching; adjusting the layout of the microstrip circuit; improving grounding; improving the rectifying bias circuit.

articleTitle: The application of closed-form mutual impedance formula in the analysis of the finite patch antenna array
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Mutual coupling of the antenna element always degenerates the performance of array antennas. The analysis of this effect using a conventional method of moments leads to a huge number of basis functions and unknowns, respectively. The mutual impedance formula between patch antennas based on synthetic asymptote and variable separation is applied to take into account the parasitic element effects through an element by element method of mutual impedance correction. This method can successfully predict the performance of the finite array as well as greatly reduce the computer time and memory usage especially in the optimization of the finite array.

articleTitle: The developing of targets' quickly-modeling software based on OpenGL
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, a new quick modeling software is presented. The model generated by the software is applied to analyze the targets' electromagnetic characteristics. The method of modeling is carried out with the key points and the surface fairing arithmetic. The output model of the software is composed of discrete grids in the form of the data files. By OpenGL, the solid image of the model is input to the GRECO, and the RCS of the target can be obtained.

articleTitle: Prediction and analysis for inter-system electromagnetic compatibility
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Prediction and analysis for inter-system electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) are studied in this paper. To study the EMC status of the systems quantitatively, electromagnetic interference margin (IM) is adopted. The inter-system IM, whether the electromagnetic interference (EMI) occurs among the systems or not can be known. Prediction and analysis of inter-system EMC are done in the information platform, some conclusions and some primary interference suppression steps are made.

articleTitle: The progress of photonic sensor development to measure the RF electric and magnetic fields
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: A new series of RF electric and magnetic field photonic sensors have being developed at the Center for Measurement Standards (CMS) of the Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) in Taiwan. The aim of this research project is to develop affordable optical electro-magnetic field sensors (OEFS and OMFS) for EMC measurement and monitoring purposes. Here we report for the first time the performance of these sensors.

articleTitle: Radiated immunity/susceptibility characteristics of actual chassis by using an electromagnetic wave of rotating polarization
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: To evaluate radiated immunity/susceptibility characteristics for the chassis of an electronics-product with complex configuration, the authors have already proposed a new test method using an electromagnetic field whose polarization rotates slowly. By using this method, three-dimensional characteristics were depicted such that weak/strong directions against various field polarizations could be obtained easily. In this paper, as an application of this method, a tower-type personal computer chassis is considered and its three dimensional characteristics are obtained. It should be mentioned that it is very difficult to theoretically evaluate and/or estimate the above characteristics. Therefore, the proposed test method would be expected in a phase of developing products.

articleTitle: Properties of a field-reduced twisted three-phase power cable of finite length
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The object of investigation is a twisted three-phase power cable of finite length. It, contains N uniform packs built up by 3 conductors, where each of the packs carries an identical three-phase current system. With respect to the 3 arbitrary phase-currents of a pack the cable forms a closed system. The cross-sections of the 3 wires belonging to a pack are arranged along straight lines which start under corresponding angles from the center of the cable. Compared with the field of a common 3-wire cable the superposition of the N magnetic three-phase fields of the single packs leads to a reduced overall field caused by compensation effects. We express the induction of the cable analytically by the help of integrals. The numerical results are displayed as 3D-plots, induction maps and diagrams of the attenuation for cables with different pack numbers N.

articleTitle: Adaptive interference cancellation technology based on blind source separation for uplink of WCDMA system
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Focusing on the WCDMA uplink, the paper proposes a spatial-temporal processing technology based on blind source separation (BSS). It aims to separate the interference from the mixtures and, as such, produce the spread spectrum signal with reduced jammer contamination, exploiting only the assumption of mutual independence between the sources, and achieves despreading at the same time. This approach can be applied further to immunise the system against the near-far effect. This decreases the system multiple access interference (MAI) and increases the system capacity. Simulation is performed to validate the superiority of the approach.

articleTitle: The effect of impedance mismatch on the conducted EMI emission
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The paper proposes a process to predict and analyze conducted electromagnetic interference (EMI) emission using the impedance mismatch approach. Five steps of this process are introduced and analyzed. The impedance mismatch criterion is proposed based on current and voltage waveforms in the time domain. The impedance mismatch fixtures and EMI measured results show how the impedance ratio and conducted EMI emission are related. The work was done using a class E zero-voltage switching (ZVS) resonant inverter at various load conditions - unity, lagging and leading power factors. The experimental results show good agreement with simulated results, which are accomplished by the MATLAB program.

articleTitle: The study of spectrum estimation in the power electronic devices based on wavelet analysis
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The EMI spectrum plays an important role in the EMC prediction of the power electronic devices. A spectrum estimation method is presented, which combines the good ability of Fourier analysis in accurate frequency localization and the features of wavelet analysis both in saltation signal processing and in adaptive signal processing, to apply a wavelet thresholding to the EMI characteristic of the system. This thresholding method has been verified by simulation and the experiment results in a power converter.

articleTitle: Indoor temporal variations at 800 MHz band
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The spatial and short time variations in the indoor radio channel are studied and determined by performing wideband propagation measurements in line of sight (LOS) and obstructed line of sight (OLOS) environments at UHF frequency of 800 MHz. It is shown that the spatial fluctuations in multipath power are more in (OLOS) than (LOS) channel. Moreover, it is shown that the short fluctuations in multipath power are higher for (LOS) than for (OLOS) channel. The results presented may be used in the design of broadband wireless LAN and serve as a basis for the development of theoretical model capable of predicting channel temporal variation characteristics under a variety conditions.

articleTitle: A study on the radio interference of the 500kV double circuit transmission lines in the Sanxia power station
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper has calculated the radio interference of the 500 kV double circuit transmission lines in the Sanxia power station, and it has analyzed and predicted the radio interference level of the 500 kV double circuit transmission lines in the Sanxia power station, together with factual metrical results of the operating lines.

articleTitle: Simulation of VSWR in axisymmetric coaxial connector
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method and the transmission lines (TL) method are used respectively in the calculation of voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) in an axisymmetric coaxial connector with nonuniform medium. Numerical results between the two methods are compared; more details of signal propagation in the connector can be given from the FDTD method, but the TL theory used is more simple and satisfactory results can also be obtained; the experimental result is in agreement with the calculations.

articleTitle: Implementation of short wave wideband data transmission by means of OFDM
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The paper presents a modem design to implement HF wideband data transmission based on orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM). In order to reduce the multipath fading effect on the short wave channel, the design adopted OFDM, inband frequency diversity, and turbo code technologies. On condition that the intensive cochannel interference is suppressed, the modem can realize transmission at data rates of 8 kb/s, 16 kb/s and 32 kb/s on a 125 kHz bandwidth HF channel. The performance of this modem in a typical HF channel is also given by digital emulation.

articleTitle: Study on the effects of relay switch of ESD simulator to ESD immunity test
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In the paper the effects of the relay switch of an ESD simulator on ESD immunity test are discussed. Using a metal mesh enclosure, we improve the simulator. Experimental results show that the shielded simulator is more coincident with the real ESD event, and the test results are more credible.

articleTitle: Application of multi-conductor transmission lines on the transient analysis in power substation
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Some structures in a power system can be modeled as multi-conductor transmission lines or transmission line in order to analyze the transient process when the switches are operated or electromagnetic pulse is imposed. In this paper the modeling of a transmission line and its finite difference time domain (FDTD) method are researched, and then extended to the transmission line network and nonuniform line. After the method is tested, some examples are finally analyzed in order to predict the transient voltage in power substations.

articleTitle: Observation of sprites over the Sea of Japan and conditions for lightning-induced sprites in winter
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Sprites are a newly discovered optical emission in the mesosphere over large thunderstorms. We have succeeded in observing sprites for winter lightning in the Hokuriku area (Japan Sea side) of Japan in the winter of 2001/2002. The optical results on three days are compared with the corresponding characteristics of parent (causative) lightning with particular attention to the significant differences between Hokuriku winter lightning and the more widely studied continental lightning. Despite significant differences with Hokuriku winter lightning, we have found nearly the same sprite properties as already observed in continental USA, with one significant difference (simpler shape for Hokuriku winter sprite). We also discuss the criteria for sprite occurrence. Specifically, two similar criteria are found: (1) cloud-to-ground discharges of positive polarity; (2) the presence of a certain threshold in vertical charge moment (200-300 C.km) (roughly consistent with that for continental USA). Mesoscale convective systems are not necessary to store the charge necessary for sprites, but the parent Hokuriku winter clouds are substantially smaller than the minimum scale for sprite occurrence in continental lightning, but they are larger in area than ordinary summer thunderclouds. However, there may exist another condition, such as clustering or the self-organizing effect of thunderclouds, for sprite production.

articleTitle: Transient analysis of unequal length multiconductor transmission lines via Haar wavelets-based numerical inversion of Laplace transform
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The numerical inversion of the Laplace transform (NILT) with Pade approximation has been used as an important tool for time domain analysis of conducted EMI coupling paths modeled by transmission line (MTL) networks. In this paper a new NILT based on Haar wavelets theory is presented for the analysis of coupled unequal length transmission line with arbitrary linear terminals and interconnecting networks. The method, which uses an operational matrix derived from the Haar wavelets theory to evaluate the image of the Laplace transform, is more accurate than previous techniques based on the Pade approximation. Two numerical examples of unequal length MTL networks are demonstrated to verify the method validity.

articleTitle: Field uniformity characteristics of an asymmetric structure reverberation chamber by FDTD method
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The conventional reverberation chamber usually has a rectangular structure including mode-stirrers or mode-tuned stirrers to obtain the field uniformity inside the chamber. This paper explains a way to improve the field uniformity in an asymmetric structure instead of a conventional rectangular structure with right-angled planes. Two types of asymmetric structure were considered. One was an asymmetric reverberation chamber using quadratic residue diffuser (QRD) and another was an asymmetric chamber with oblique enclosure including fixed randomly made diffusers (RMD). The FDTD simulation method was used to analyse the field homogeneous characteristics of these two types asymmetric reverberation chambers.

articleTitle: Dielectric embedded-electronically steerable multiple beam (DE-ESMB) antenna for mobile wireless computing system
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper presents a newly developed dielectric embedded and electronically steerable multiple beam (DE-ESMB) antenna and its applications in wireless communication system. The DE-ESMB antenna can be also used in a wireless computing system. DE-ESMB is a smart mobile terminal antenna using switching antenna technology and size reduction techniques. The significant performance of the DE-ESMB smart antenna has been achieved in terms of the size reduction and switched beamforming. The paper also discusses the optimal design techniques of using a high-performance computer to design the DE-ESMB antenna array.

articleTitle: Conversion between the method of measurement of electrified railway radio disturbance in our country and the method stipulated by EN standard
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: By test and statistical analysis, this paper derives a conversion coefficient between our method of measurement of electrified railway radio disturbance (ERRD) and the method stipulated by the EN50-121 standard. Then the evaluation of the level of ERRD in the state was carried out with the limit stipulated by the EN standard. This provides the foundation for us to apply the EN standard in China in the future.

articleTitle: Effects of electromagnetic pulses on approximate entropy of multichannel EEG in freely moving rats
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: To study the effects of the electromagnetic pulses (EMP) on the electrical activity of the brain, chronic electrode implantation techniques were developed to record the multichannel EEG signals, and the approximate entropy was applied to study the changes in EEG after the rats were exposed to EMP. Sixteen rats were randomly divided into 2 groups, EMP group and sham exposure group. EEG was recorded before and after EMP exposures repeatedly. ApEn was then calculated to evaluate the effects of EMP on EEG. The results showed that: (1) the ApEn of the normal EEG ranged between 0.30 and 0.71, and ApEn in different brain areas of the normal rats was not symmetrically distributed; (2) after the exposure, ApEn of the EEG in the exposed rats were significantly increased (P<0.01) except for Ch7 and Ch15. This indicated that exposed to EMP may result in the changes of the electrical activity of the brain under the given experiment conditions.

articleTitle: Development of a small passive electro-optic EMP sensor
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: A small passive electro-optic EMP sensor with the frequency range from 0.1 Hz to 700 MHz has been developed. This sensor can detect the field strength from 0.5 V/m to about 3000 V/m using different lengths of dipole antenna. The small probe size and all-dielectric fiber-optic cabling of the passive electro-optic probe allows for nonintrusive pulsed E-field measurement in small enclosure or complicated electromagnetic environments.

articleTitle: Study on the measurement of HV insulator's leakage current based on the adaptive noise cancellation theory
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In the electric power system HV transmits, contamination flashover in the HV insulator is getting worse and worse, so a way to find an HV insulator which is being invalid is of great importance in the measurement of HV insulator leakage current. On the basis of the theory of adaptive noise cancellation and adaptive line enhancement, we have provided an improved adaptive noise cancellation used in the measurement of HV insulator leakage current, which is of good performance not only in the case of LF noise cancellation like the adaptive line enhancement, but also in the case of LF noise cancellation like the normal adaptive noise cancellation, and it is proved to be efficient and robust through emulation and simulation experiments.

articleTitle: A modified digital measuring method on flickering
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The computational method of flickering is discussed closely and a new advanced method based on the FFT algorithm is put forward. In the course of a test environment that is IEC regulated, a simulation based on Matlab is completed. The test proves that the new method can both simplify the calculation and meet the requirements of accuracy that IEC demand.

articleTitle: A generalized algorithm for antenna near-field computation in EMC prediction
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: A generalized method for analysis of antenna near field is presented which relies on both additivity of radiation field of discrete antenna elements and sampling method of an aperture field. It has advantages of implementing easily and saving the computing time and storage. Some results are compared with published data, and the agreement is good. It can be widely used in EMC prediction.

articleTitle: Fractal feature extraction of radar emitter signals
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, a novel effective approach based on fractal theory is proposed to extract features of radar emitter signals. Box dimension and information dimension are used as classification features to recognize the types of intra-pulse modulation of radar signals. It is proved in both theory and experiments that the features are not sensitive to noise. Experimental results show that the features have good characteristics of clustering the same radar signals and separating different radar signals.

articleTitle: The setup of high frequency circuit model for current transformer
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: A circuit model to simulate the high frequency behavior (0.1-15 MHz) of an inductive current transformer (CT) is presented. This model is based on the frequency characteristics between its terminals over a given range of frequency obtained by measurement. The transfer function model for the PT (potential transformer) is approximated with rational functions by means of vector fitting. A special method of RLC synthesis for the transfer function is used to build the circuit model of the CT. This high frequency circuit model can be used to calculate the disturbing voltage in the secondary circuit caused by transients in the primary through capacitive coupling in an air insulated substation (AIS).

articleTitle: Experiments on the susceptibility of the direct digital control system to EMP in intelligent buildings
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Direct digital control (DDC) systems now play an important role in intelligent control of modern buildings. The susceptibility of these control systems to the pulsed electromagnetic environment is studied. A model of a DDC system consisting of computer, communication line and digital controller was tested in a HEMP simulator and a pulsed magnetic field simulator. We measured the interference thresholds of the computer and the DDC controller as well as the coupling of the outside field to the shielded twisted lines. The communication line was found to be the main path that causes interference in the DDC. Protection approaches, which can greatly reduce the sensitivity of the system to EMP interference, were also developed for the system.

articleTitle: Emulation research about feasibility of reducing dihedral corner reflector RCS with plasma
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: A dihedral corner reflector has a wide-angle dispersion characteristic, and it is a primary scattering position in certain orientations of a metal body. Furthermore, the technology is quite complex for its radar cross section (RCS) to be reduced. The paper first investigates the technological feasibility of reducing its RCS with plasma. Then, the RCS variations of a metal corner reflector when its surfaces are covered with plasma are analyzed by software emulation (the experimental equipment is being developed). The results show that the plasma has strong electromagnetic wave absorption characteristics. In addition, the attenuation of RCS declines with increasing incident wave frequency when the plasma. frequency and electron collision frequency remain steady. The results show that application of a plasma has practical engineering value in terms of reducting the RCS.

articleTitle: A study on the field radiated by ESD
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: For evaluating electrostatic discharge radiation immunity test of electronic devices, by simulation and modeling, the paper has investigated the characteristics of the field radiated by the electrostatic discharge current that is specified in the IEC61000-4-2 standard.

articleTitle: The method to generalize engineering return stroke models
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: A method to generalize most engineering models is proposed. With the proposed method, the current discontinuity in the BG (Bruce-Golde) and TCS (traveling current source) models vanishes, and the generalized engineering models exhibit a good agreement with the measured optical characteristic features of the lightning return stroke, while the waveforms predicted by the generalized models still exhibit the same characteristic features as the original models. The influence of realistic features, such as a decrease in the return stroke speed and an increase in the current risetime with height, on associated electromagnetic field waveforms is investigated, and the results show that these two features tend to weaken the magnetic hump, but have no significant influence on the zero-crossing time.

articleTitle: High frequency model and parameter sensitivity analysis of EMI filter's characteristic in switched mode power supply
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: EMI filters are commonly used to suppress the EMI in SMPS, but their frequency characteristics, especially in the high frequency band, are usually much worse in a real system than the design expectation. The paper conducts a study on an EMI filter's HF model, and then makes an analysis of the sensitivity of the filter frequency characteristic to parameters based on the rather accuracy model; the results show that they may be helpful for performance design optimization of a filter and its conducted EMI debugging.

articleTitle: A EMC design for PC104 I/O module
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Noise sources and fundamental mechanisms leading to radiated emissions from printed circuit boards (PCBs) have been analyzed. The use of photoelectric couplers at the input and output interfaces between PCBs and of image planes on the PCBs reduces common-mode radiation; the effectiveness has been proved to comply with GJB151A-97 EMI limits.

articleTitle: Wave perturbations in upper atmosphere from pulsed sources
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In this work observations are discussed in the response of the gravitation signal of the sounding inclined Doppler of the low acoustic (LFA) and internal gravitation (IGW) of waves in upper atmosphere, formed from pulsed sources: the process of earthquake preparing; the start of the rocket. In both events sources have broadband (/spl delta/-figurative) spectrum. The difference is concluded that in the process of preparing the earthquake source is found on land surfaces, and at the stairwell of a rocket in the upper atmosphere. The analysis given allows us to value the passband of the upper sound channel, and the band in which possible registration of the wave indignations are conditioned by earthquakes.

articleTitle: The EMI design of low power isolated converter based on near field measure
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In the design of a low cost, low weight, small size and high performance power converter, EMI design is a challenging task. The paper discuses the EMI design difference between low power and high power converters, and presents methods of passive cancellation of common mode current emission to reduce conducted EMI emissions and radiated emissions in a low power isolated converter. EMI design techniques based on near field measures are presented. A 2W flyback converter has been designed and results are experimentally verified.

articleTitle: Effects of pulsed magnetic field on personal computers
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Around a lightning conductor or a metal construction which conducts a transient electric current, there is a strong pulsed magnetic field. A pulsed magnetic field simulation system was developed to study the effect of strong magnetic pulses on a micro-electronic system. In the experiment, personal computers were put into the electromagnetic environment of the simulator. Coupling paths, interference threshold, the relation of the threshold to rise time and duration of the field were studied by changing the peak value, duration and rise time of the simulated pulsed magnetic field. Results show that the connecting cables are the main paths that introduce interference; simple shielding can reduce the interference to some extent and the interference is more likely to affect the micro-electronic system if its time derivative is larger.

articleTitle: Evaluation of uncertainties for loop antenna calibration
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Loop antennas can be calibrated by the standard magnetic field method. This method uses two loop antennas to precisely generate and measure the magnetic field; the frequency range is 10 kHz to 30 MHz. In this paper, calibration uncertainties in the measurement process are discussed; the calibration procedure is also presented.

articleTitle: Modeling of wide-band frequency characteristic of current transformer
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Switching operations cause transient currents in the primary circuits in substations. For the prediction of the interference currents in the secondary circuits caused by the transient currents in the primary circuits, wideband frequency models of the current transformers (CT) are needed The paper presents a modified synthesis method for the current transfer function. After the current transfer characteristics of the CT are measured, the wideband frequency models of the CT can be set up with the synthesis method. The method is simple and effective.

articleTitle: Test of correlation between GTEM cell and open area test site emission measurements
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper derives in detail the horizontal radiated electric fields from an electrically small radiator which should be well represented by the leading multipole moments, namely, the electric dipole and the magnetic moments, correcting Lee's corresponding formula. A sequence of GTEM cell measurements is made to determine the equivalent dipole moments of the device under test (DUT). Based on the correlation between GTEM cell and OATS emission measurements, theoretical simulation for DUT emissions over an open area test site (OATS) have been made. Theoretical results and experimental data measured directly over OATS are compared with good agreement.

articleTitle: The shelter and reflection effect research of the viaduct of JingHu high speed railway to TV signal
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The paper analyses the effect of a high viaduct and a train on TV signals from two side: shelter effect and reflection effect, based on the theory of electric wave propagation and gives the measured data as confirmation. By comparison and analysis, we can know how and to what extent the TV signal will be affected by all kinds of parameters.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of the novel feed-in scheme for LO based on the near-field coupling
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: A novel feeding scheme of local oscillator feeding based on the near-field coupling was proposed in Luan et al. (2003). The coupling effectiveness between two single feeding elements as well as the microstrip arrays was investigated, showing that a good transportation of the power may be realized through appropriate design. This paper presents the experimental results for both transmitting efficiency and assembling tolerance. Very close agreement has been obtained between simulated and measured performance of the proposed feeding scheme.

articleTitle: Effects of electromagnetic pulses on the blood-brain barrier of rats
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Animals were exposed to EMP with field intensity 25, 50, 100, 200 and 400 kV/m, and 25, 50, 100 and 200 pulses; duration between every two pulses is 2s. Firstly, an Evans blue (EB) and fluorescent microscope were used to observe the changes in the permeability of BBB after exposed to different combinations of the parameters. Secondly, an electron microscope was used to investigate the effects of EMP on the ultrastructure of different areas in the hippocampus and the marginal division of the brain after injection of lanthanum nitrate. Results showed that the permeability of the BBB of the rat can be changed after exposure to EMP with a significant dose-effect relationship. With the increasing of field intensity and raising of pulse number, the number and the area of spots increased so too the intensity of fluorescent colorations. Morphological changes in BBB and nervous tissue after EMP exposure also showed dose-effect relationship. The lanthanum nitrate granules appeared in the tissue of the cortex, hippocampus and hypothalamus in the EMP exposed group. The process of the granules crossing through the tight junction of capillary vessels and the phagocytosis of the granules in the endothelium cells were presented. Exposure to EMP can lead to increased permeability of BBB and could damage the endothelium cells of the capillary, resulting in increases of the perivascular space of the capillary.

articleTitle: Influences of a 500 kV DC resistive divider's stray parameters on measurement results
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The influences of electromagnetic transient on a 500 kV DC resistive divider are discussed based on the equivalent circuit considering stray parameters in this paper A finite element method is applied to evaluate the stray parameters of the DC resistive divider and PSpice software is used to simulate the responses of the equivalent circuit. The simulation results are analyzed and conclusions of influences on measurement results of the DC resistive divider are achieved.

articleTitle: Rational comparison of field strength between semi-anechoic chamber and fully anechoic chamber
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In this article the validation of a fully anechoic chamber adopted to perform an EMI compliance test is explored by conducting test and theoretical analysis, and a preferred limit which is correlated to the present limit based on OATS is provided.

articleTitle: Development of user-friendly software to visualize ELF electric field exposed to human body
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: For the study of biological effects of ELF electric fields, a flexible and user-friendly software was developed to calculate the spatial distribution of the ELF electric field and the induced current around and inside a human body. The accuracy of the calculation was confirmed by measurements.

articleTitle: Ionospheric perturbation associated with earthquakes, as revealed from subionospheric VLF/LF propagation
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: NASDA (National Space Development Agency of Japan) has just finished the Earthquake Remote Sensing Frontier Project conducted since 1996 within the framework of the Earthquake Frontier Projects by the former STA (Science and Technology Agency). The main emphasis of NASDA's Frontier Project was the complete understanding of lithosphere-atmosphere-ionosphere (LAI) coupling by making full use of different kinds of observational items and finally we contribute to the short-term earthquake prediction. The most exciting finding from our Frontier project was the discovery of convincing evidence on the presence of seismo-ionospheric perturbations, which has been extensively investigated by using the subionospheric VLF/LF propagation, and several important findings have been presented, including the initial result for the Kobe earthquake and a few case studies from much data.

articleTitle: Predicting the secondary electromagnetic reflection on the complex targets
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper presents a quick and effective arithmetic to search geminate cells where secondary scattering exists between them, and establishes a secondary scattering theory model in the near-field. The secondary incidence field on a cell is decided by geometrical optics (GO). And physical optics (PO) decides the secondary scattering field. It can also be applied to far-field and near-field.

articleTitle: Estimation of the EMP response of a system from its continuous wave measurement results
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Traditionally, the electromagnetic protection ability of a system, such as filters, shielding enclosures, etc., is measured in the frequency-domain and expressed as insertion loss or shielding effectiveness. When the time-domain characteristics of the system are required to evaluate their pulse response, time-domain tests need to be conducted. However, it may not be convenient to carried out time-domain tests because of the availability of test facilities. Theoretically, suppose the system works in a linear range, its pulse response can be estimated from frequency-domain measured data. We evaluated this concept by experiments. A digital filter model of the system under test is used to approximate the measured frequency response and then employed to calculate the output of the system under pulsed input. The estimated pulse responses are compared with measured ones. Results show that it is possible to estimate approximately the magnitude and shape of the time-domain response by this approach.

articleTitle: Proceedings. Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics (IEEE Cat. No.03EX702)
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: EMC in communication; EMC in computers and PCB; electromagnetic bioeffects; EM field theory; EM environment and EMI sources; ESD and EMP; seismo-electromagnetic phenomena; antennas, probes and EM sensors; transmission line theory; immunity and susceptibility; EMI prediction analysis and reduction techniques; lightning filtering, shielding and grounding; coupling and crosstalk EM calculation; EM wave propagation and scattering; and EMC measurement.

articleTitle: Investigation on characteristics of computer electromagnetic leakage based on GTEM measurement
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, we endeavor to investigate the characteristics of computer electromagnetic leakage based on GTEM measurement. We take several steps to measure the spectrum of computer emission, and the characteristics of computer emission are obtained by analysis both in frequency domain and time domain.

articleTitle: Estimation of current distribution by near-field measurement
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: A method to estimate the current distribution by measuring the near-field distribution has been proposed and applied to the Yagi-Uda antenna. The optimum parameters to scan the near field, such as the positions for measuring the near field, the area of scanning plane, and the number of measuring points for near field measurement have been determined by using the condition number. Numerically estimated results are presented and compared with the real data, confirming the validity of the method.

articleTitle: Computation of resonant frequencies of cavities by FDTD technique based on wave equation approach
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper presents a novel finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method to calculate the resonant frequencies of cavity structures. The FDTD formulation, based on the wave equation, employs approximation techniques. The proposed algorithm takes a much shorter time than the standard FDTD method. The theory is verified by comparison with the analytic result.

articleTitle: Measurement of the frequency-dependent dielectric constant of concrete materials by TDR and wavelet modeling method
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Time-domain reflectometry has been widely used in the measurement of material electromagnetic properties. In order to obtain the spectrum of the dielectric constant, the measured waveforms need to be analyzed by FFT. Because of multi-reflections in the measured waveform, it is sometimes difficult to extract a clear reflection for analysis and the final results may not be accurate. A wavelet modeling method was used in this paper to extract the frequency-dependent dielectric constant in the measured time-domain waveform. By transforming the measured signal into a series of frequency bands and recognizing it according to the composition of reflections, this method can reduce the effect of multi-reflections on the measurement results.

articleTitle: Scattering of ultrashort electromagnetic pulses by nonlinearly reflecting targets
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Nonlinear radiolocation is very promising for future remote sensing systems and it has been proposed for sensible determination and recognition of objects, including elements with different nonlinear electromagnetic characteristics. It is based on the fact that generation of higher harmonics occurs under scattering of electromagnetic waves by nonlinearly loaded conducting targets. Investigating re-reflected harmonics, one can determine a nonlinear object, and also obtain additional information. The paper investigates numerically the scattering of ultrashort electromagnetic pulses by the following models of nonlinear scatterers: nonlinearly loaded vibrator; two-dimensional plate. The calculations give the possibility of determining optimal values of electromagnetic probing pulse duration needed to obtain the maximal useful reflected signal.

articleTitle: The reflection and transmission of electromagnetic wave from small particle-dielectric composites sheet
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The electromagnetic properties of composites which are made of small particles imbedded in an insulating matrix have been studied. The electromagnetic fields inside and outside the sphere particles were derived using Mie theory, and the renormalized permittivity and permeability that take into account effect of retardation were introduced. When the skin effect in metal is strong by high frequency electromagnetic field under conditions for the metal-dielectric composites, the developed effective medium theory (DEMT) is more suited than the effective medium theory (EMT) to describe the properties of composites. Numerical results exhibit the characteristics of reflection and transmission of electromagnetic waves at composite sheets.

articleTitle: Digital frequency conversion technique in HDTV
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The paper describes research on the fundamental principle of digital modulation and frequency conversion in broadband digital broadcasting-terrestrial TV ( BDB-T) system. Different from conventional down-conversion techniques, a new digital down-conversion model is proposed which utilizes the Hilbert transform. A method eliminating the A/D DC offset in this model is also proposed. The corresponding FPGA hardware is tested in an HDTV prototype and proves the efficiency and good performance of the model and the new method.

articleTitle: Information of soil moisture extraction from microwave scattered field
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In active microwave remote sensing of soil moisture, the electric field scattered by the soil surface contains information about the soil. Three kinds of a priori knowledge hypotheses are considered for their influence on soil moisture inversion. The neural network (NN) toolbox in MATLAB is used to invert the soil moisture and compute the soil moisture error produced by the uncertainty of these three kinds of hypotheses.

articleTitle: The reflection, transmission, and absorption of microwave in nonuniform plasma
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: We study the reflection, transmission, and absorption of microwaves in nonuniform plasma. A discussion of the effect of various plasma parameters (such as electron density, collision frequency, etc.) on the reflected power, transmitted power and absorbed power of the microwave is presented.
