The nonuniform plasma slab studied is modeled by a series of subslabs, in each of which the electron density is assumed to be constant. We assume that the number density is constant in each subslab, and then the overall electron density is subject to a parabolic distribution. The total reflected, absorbed, and transmitted powers could then be deduced according to the calculation of the partial reflection coefficient and transmission coefficient at each slab.

articleTitle: New microstrip triangular patch resonators filters with two transmission zeros
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: New microstrip triangular patch resonator filters with two transmission zeros are proposed. The proposed bandpass filters have two transmission zeros on both sides of the passband. The effects of varying the parameters of the structure have been studied. The filters have been verified by simulation and measurement with good agreement.

articleTitle: The calculating and analysis of shielding effectiveness of metal meshes in transient electromagnetic interference
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The shielding effectiveness of many sorts of metal meshes in transient electromagnetic interference, such as lightning, etc., is calculated based on the Fourier transform algorithm. The calculation result shows that the higher the material resistivity and the thinner the mesh radius, the greater is the effect of mesh radius on shielding effectiveness. When the mesh number is fewer, the effect of mesh radius on electric current becomes greater. So the shielding material with a higher mesh number is less affected by mesh radius than that with a lower mesh number.

articleTitle: The analysis of the shielding efficiency for the hermetic structure with the finger-reed
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: An electromagnetic leakage problem often appears at a shielding door's aperture, and the usual method to resolve it is to apply some kind of electrical gasket to the shielding door. The finger-reed is a typical electrical gasket with broad application. The influence of the dimensions of a finger-reed structure on shielding efficiency is first analyzed by FDTD method. Then, the shielding efficiency for an electromagnetic pulse is investigated when a finger shaped reed is installed in an aperture of a metal structure. The computational results coincide well with those of experimental results. Finally, some conclusions, which may provide a helpful reference for practical engineering, are obtained.

articleTitle: The character of approximation between the waveforms of LEMP in remote area and channel-base current
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The electromagnetic field is calculated by the dipole technique. The waveforms of EM field in remote area and the channel-base current are compared. Also the derivative of EM field in remote area and that of the channel-base current are compared. According to the comparison, it shows that the qualification of approximation between the EM field and channel-base current is more strict than that between the derivative of the EM field and channel-base current.

articleTitle: Influence on aerial optical fibre cable from external electromagnetic field
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The paper presents an estimation of the electrical field intensity on the surface of an aerial fibre cable suspended next to a high voltage transmission line. By analogy with the current on a heavily soiled petticoat surface, it is supposed the that value of the surface current can be some tens of milliamperes. Protection can be made by using a crimped cable sheath.

articleTitle: A prospective solution of EMC during mobile communications - software method
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Advances in software radio research for mobile communications systems over recent years are described. The five tiers solutions defined by the SDR Forum are presented. It is shown that for mobile communications, the software radio method may be a prospective and complete solution to EMC. The authors propose that the Chinese information industries and government administration authority should have a foresight on this area and take measures to develop this industry in China.

articleTitle: The analysis of attenuation characteristics for HEMP passing through the air-tight door
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The attenuation characteristics of high-altitude nuclear blast electromagnetic pulse (HEMP) passing through the infinite metal board are obtained in this paper and the influence caused by aperture is analyzed synchronously. On the basis of these properties, the methods that can improve shielding efficiency (SE) are discussed by combining the application for the air-tight door then many experimental results are given.

articleTitle: Extension of R-FDTD algorithm for solving Maxwell equations in homogeneous isotropic lossy media
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: An attractive advance in the use of the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method has been the introduction of the reduced FDTD (R-FDTD) algorithm, which can reduce computer memory requirement in the storage of the fields by up to 33%. The initial implementation is limited for solving Maxwell equations in isotropic lossless media. This paper introduces an extension of R-FDTD algorithm. The proposed extension uses the FDTD formula of the Maxwell curl equations to eliminate one component each of E and H. This enables us have a memory-efficient formulation for solving Maxwell equations in homogeneous isotropic lossy media.

articleTitle: Numerical study of ESD field distribution in a metallic cavity
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, the distribution of the electromagnetic field generated by electrostatic discharge spark in a metallic cavity is analyzed using the FDTD method and a numerical model of the field distribution is established. The field distributions while discharging at the center of the cavity and at the center of the cavity wall are calculated respectively using the model and some conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: Analysis of microwave interference suppression power-line filter
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Serial connection of an LC filter and a microwave absorption filter can achieve good interference suppression performance from 10 kHz to 10 GHz, but the suppression ability of the filter is insufficient above 10 GHz. /spl lambda//4 short and open circuit transmission lines are used to construct a reflection filter, to improve the interference suppression ability of the filter above 10 GHz, specifically between 8 GHz and 18 GHz.

articleTitle: The research on video signal electromagnetic radiation of computer based on near-field testing data
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Computer circuits are very complex and there are various signals in them. A computer can radiate electromagnetic waves when working. Some of these radiations may result in computer information leakage. A video signal electromagnetic radiation model is set up based on near zone testing data, and the far zone video electromagnetic radiation is estimated using computational electromagnetics. Furthermore, it is proposed to investigate noise in the propagation path using the FDTD method, and the noise is modeled as a stochastic process rather than determined variables. Thus, the time-variant characteristic of noise in the propagation path is studied. Then, electromagnetic radiation with 16 dB degrees is simulated. Lastly, the recovered word images are given, after the video electromagnetic information leakage is processed through synchronization, correlated filtering, phase locking, recognition and reconstruction technology, etc. The characteristics of information leakage are studied and discussed.

articleTitle: A new method to calculate the coupling between spatial electromagnetic wave and parallel transmission lines on PCB
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: A new method to calculate the coupling between a spatial electromagnetic wave and parallel transmission lines on a PCB is presented. The antenna reciprocity theorem is introduced to avoid the complex scattering problem by calculating the radiation of the parallel lines. Besides, the coupling length is defined to describe the coupling voltage of the loads; its frequency characteristics are also discussed.

articleTitle: Power transfer of transient electromagnetic fields through a plane conducting screen of finite thickness
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The calculation of transient electromagnetic fields is important because of the increasing demands on system design under EMC constraints. The shielding effectiveness of a screen is characterized by the time dependence of the electromagnetic energy transfer into the shielded area caused by switched or pulsed sources. The total energy which is radiated by the transient wave can be calculated by integrating Poynting's vector over an appropriate closed surface and over the time interval between the switching moment and infinity. In this work the power and energy balance for the electromagnetic fields excited by electromagnetic sources in the presence of a plane conducting and permeable screen are presented. Also, the results obtained by the quasi-stationary method are compared to those calculated via the full-dynamic approach.

articleTitle: Monitoring VLF- and LF- signal as one of the possible methods of the earthquakes forecast building
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: On the basis of the measuring-receiving complex of electromagnetic background monitoring developed in the Siberian Physical Technical Institute, the comparative analysis of continuous records of amplitude variation for VLF and LF-signals of three radio stations is resulted.

articleTitle: Estimation of polarization mode dispersion (PMD) value in optical fibre during lightning strokes
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The paper presents the approximate estimation of the PMD in an optical fibre, that occurs as a consequence of the electromagnetic field of a lightning stroke to earth in the vicinity of the fibre cable. The estimation is based on an analogy with the calculation of PMD in a fibre with eccentricity. A small rotation of the polarization plane of light in a fibre under the influence of a lightning field causes the same distribution of orthogonal modes to the main axis as a small eccentricity. Estimation can be made by this method if rotation is less than 20 grad.

articleTitle: Crosstalk analysis for TLs in special directions
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper crosstalk between transmission lines. (TL) in special directions such as perpendicular and parallel is studied in the frequency domain and time domain via electromagnetic field (EMF) theory. Magnitude of crosstalk between the two states is compared. Regulations of when the peaks or troughs should occur are summarized, results are verified with that of the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis on ring network of Scalable Coherent Interface
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The paper discusses the problem of reliability modeling on the Scalable Coherent Interface (SCI) in a distributed real-time avionics system. Considering the system to be degradable, we propose a message-based source-termination reliability model for the SCI network. Numerical computations have been done to present the results graphically and a mathematical proof has also been given.

articleTitle: Time domain measure system of the magnetic shielding effectiveness
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In order to measure the magnetic shielding effectiveness of buildings such as reinforced concrete construction, metal enclosure, a portable measurement device was developed. Its principle, structure and parameters are introduced in this paper. In order to improve performance the optic fiber system was used in the system. The measure program was written in Matlab. A wide range of frequency properties can be obtained from one time-domain measurement. Finally an example is presented.

articleTitle: Problems with the electrostatic discharge (ESD) immunity test in electromagnetic compatibility (EMC)
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The electrostatic discharge (ESD) immunity test is one of the important electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) tests. The IEC standard IEC61000-4-2 is the widely used standard to test the ESD immunity for electronic equipment. Many amendments such as amendment 1 (1998), and amendment 2 (2000) have been published since 1995, but there are still problems with the ESD immunity test even with the 200x version. More than six ESD generators of different bands are tested for different equipments. The results show that the failure voltages of different ESD generators vary widely from different bands for the same test equipment. This may lead to noncomparable results when testing the ESD immunity in the EMC. Further studies show that there is a good correlation between the failure voltage and the induced voltage.

articleTitle: The analysis of radiation diagram and transmission efficiency for imperfect radome
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, a study of the radiation diagram and transmission efficiency for an imperfect radome is presented. Based on the ray tracing method, the results of computer simulation show the changes of radiation diagrams and transmission efficiency caused by outside damage for two types of radomes.

articleTitle: The method of intelligent operation of circuit breaker to reduce overvoltage
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Operating overvoltage appears when a circuit breaker, especially a high-voltage circuit breaker, opens and closes, which causes strong electromagnetic interference (EMI) and even damage to power and electrical equipment near the circuit breaker We analyze the factors which create operating overvoltage. Based on the breakdown theory of critical electric strength, the sensitivity of the gap between open contacts to the non-uniform coefficient of electric field is considered, the characteristics of dielectric recovery are calculated, methods of reducing or avoiding the operating overvoltage are put forward. They are realized by changing the simple moving characteristics of the circuit breaker, such as the initial phase confirmed in closing, the current phase selected and the diameter of the drain oil aperture of the operating mechanism being adjusted in the opening of an intelligent operation circuit breaker.

articleTitle: Calculation of the equivalent attractive area of horizontal conductors
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper proposes an efficient method for calculating the equivalent attractive area of horizontal conductors. The border of the collection volume is defined in the directrix curve equation. Inside the collection volume the incident area of downward leader is found by using an improved geometrical algorithm, in which the probability distribution of the approach angle of the downward leader is taken into account. In terms of the probability density of lightning striking distance, an integral operation is performed for obtaining the equivalent attractive area. The calculated result is compared with those from the empirical formulae to check the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Modelling fluorescent luminaires for EMC compliance assessment
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: One of the issues faced by manufacturers of fluorescent luminaires is the vast number of models they have to contemplate in the light of an EMC compliance regime. By modelling the luminaire's electrical circuit with lumped elements, this paper investigates the insertion loss performance of a number of fluorescent luminaires, and the effects of the power-factor correction capacitor on the insertion loss performance, to enable a quick evaluation of each luminaire model.

articleTitle: Radiation from a portable terminal
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The oldest approach to the exposure of an operator of a portable terminal was based upon the HF EM energy absorption in his/her head. The conducting current was firstly mentioned by the author in 1994 in Sendai. Then, in 2000, the presence of LF fields around a terminal was discovered and presented (Trzaska, H., Proc. Asia-Pacific Conf. on Environmental Electromagnetics, CEEM'2000, p.72-5, 2000). The latest investigations include studies of envelope detection in a living body and the presence of LF potentials in the body. Macroscopic detection has still not been confirmed, but detection on a microscopic level was discovered and a proposal for the electrotherapy at a distance (teleelectrotherapy) was presented.

articleTitle: Linear method of EMI measurements in GTEM cell
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: A new method of EMI measurement in GTEM cells, the linear method, is brought out in this paper. A series of experiments were performed to prove the validity and advantage of this method. The results yield hardly significant differences between this method and the well-known Wilson method, which means that the linear method can be considered in the practice by reason of its simpleness, self-consistency and good adaptability.

articleTitle: A practical compact loaded microstrip antenna
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: A compact loaded microstrip antenna operating at 2.4 GHz is presented in the paper. It is similar in configuration to a conventional patch antenna fed by a microstrip-line, but its dimension is much smaller than that of the latter due to the existence of a load. The antenna has been investigated numerically and experimentally. Simulated and measured, results show that the antenna has a bandwidth of over 10% centered at 2.4 GHz.

articleTitle: Simulation of time base error in planar time-domain near-field measurement
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper discuss near-field amplitude and phase deviation caused by time base error, and furthermore discusses the corresponding far-field deviation; finally, a conclusion has been reached according to the simulation results.

articleTitle: A new EFG-FEM algorithm for electromagnetic computation
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: A new algorithm to couple the element free Galerkin method (EFG) with FEM is proposed to deal with the boundary and interface continuity problem met in the EFG method. Its discrete equation is deduced, and some computation examples for EM problems are given. The results show that the boundary conditions are applied as well as FEM.

articleTitle: An exploration for optimal parameters of electromagnetic impulse on electrochemotherapy (ECT) of tumor
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Electrochemotherapy (ECT) is a new and efficient approach for the treatment of tumors. It uses an electromagnetic impulse plus anticancer drugs to treat a tumor. The technique is very easy to control and operate and is of little harm to normal tissue. Especially, it is very efficient in curing flat tumors. We have used ECT to treat S-180 sarcomas in KunMing mice. In the experiment, we explored the optimal parameters of the electromagnetic impulse used in the treatment and acquired elementary results.

articleTitle: A simple method to analyze the wire antenna on the conductor
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, a simple method to analyze the wire antenna on conductor is proposed. The analysis is based on the moment method (Rao et al. (1982)). The analysis has been performed hitherto by developing a junction model of the point where the antenna is attached to the conductor. The junction model method can model the problem very well. However it brings complexity in the computing. Here, we present a simple method, which can give a good analysis result.

articleTitle: A concise expression for PO method on electromagnetic scattering by arbitrary shaped conducting targets with partially coating
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: By approximating electrically large scale objects with polygons, a concise expression for the physical optics (PO) method on electromagnetic scattering by arbitrary shaped conducting targets with partial coating is proposed in this paper, which is based on the theory of equivalent currents on arbitrary radio absorbing material (RAM) surface with infinite metal substrate. The fact that there are only simple algebraic operations without integration in our formula makes the calculation highly efficient and provides a good high-speed estimation of the RCS of electrically large scale conducting bodies with partial coating.

articleTitle: Some effective methods in computational electromagnetics
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Some effective methods in computational electromagnetics other than those involved in commercial software are introduced. These methods include a space mapping technique, extra port method to involve parasitic influence, extrapolation and adaptive frequency sampling techniques, synthetic asymptote technique and artificial neural network technique. Their mechanisms, such as getting formulas or making use of the mapping between different levels, are not quite the same. They have the same goal, which is to make a good balance between accuracy and efficiency. The principle of each method is briefly addressed. Some research work done in the author's laboratory or in cooperation with others is introduced. Finally some future research work is suggested.

articleTitle: Analysis of the electromagnetic scattering of rivets on the conducting plate
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, the electric field integral equation (EFIE) in conjunction with the moment method is used to analyze the electromagnetic scattering problem of rivets on the conducting plate. The surfaces of the rivets and the plate are partitioned into triangular cells, the current distribution on the patches is represented by a subdomain-type basis function, the EFIE is translated into a matrix equation by the Galerkin method, then the current coefficient is obtained. Results show the properties of RCS varying with the incident angle when there are rivets on the plate. Furthermore, we can see the effect of rivets on RCS.

articleTitle: The gene expression of superoxide dismutase and the changes of the ultrastructure of rat testis after exposed to electromagnetics
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The aim is to study the expression of superoxide dismutase (CuZnSOD, MnSOD) and the changes of ultrastructure in rat testis after electromagnetic radiation (EMR) so as to investigate the mechanisms of EMR effect on procreation. As an in vivo model, male SD rats were used. Rats were exposed to the field of electromagnetics. By reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR), manganese SOD (MnSOD) and copper/zinc SOD (CuZnSOD) mRNA in the testis have been tested and the testis samples were prepared for transmission electron microscopy to observe the ultrastructure at 6h, 12h, 24h and 48h after radiation. In rat testis, MnSOD mRNA expression decreased at 24h and CuZnSOD mRNA expression did not change after radiation; the ratio of MnSOD/CuZnSOD decreased at 24h after radiation. These were some degree injuries in the testis at different time after radiation, the testis damage at 24h was more serious than that at other times after radiation. At 24h after exposure, the chromatin was gathered in the border and the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) was dilated and vacuolated in interstitial cells, spermatogonium cells of rat testis. The changes in sustentacular cells was more serious than the other cells. The results showed that the MnSOD gene expression was decreased and the ultrastructure of rat testis were damaged after exposure to electromagnetics. These changes may induce the other effects, and the change of MnSOD expression might reflect a defensive mechanism of rat body against oxidative stress. If these changes would not regain in time, they may cause worse effects. Thus, EMR could induce some changes in the testis of rats so as to alter the procreative function.

articleTitle: An improved diffraction tomographic inversion technique for imaging near-surface buried objects
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: A new diffraction tomography algorithm for the detection of near-surface buried objects with ground penetrating radar (GPR) is derived. Improved image quality is obtained by avoiding an asymptotic approximation made by previous algorithms. This new diffraction tomography technique is shown to outperform its predecessor.

articleTitle: Calculate the SE of wire structures using NEC
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The validity of calculating the shielding effectiveness (SE) of complex metal wire structures using NEC software, which is based on MoM, is verified and the SE of a structure which is built with reinforcing wires is discussed on the basis of the results calculated using NEC.

articleTitle: Transmission properties of slits on stacked thick plates using a three-wave FDTD approach
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: To analyze the scattering properties of slits on single or stacked metal plates of finite thickness, a three-wave FDTD approach is applied. By using this scheme, we calculate the magnetic surface currents on both sides of a slit on a thick plate and the transmission cross sections of slits on single or thick plates. The numerical examples are given to demonstrate the accuracy of the method. In addition, we observe that the shift of the two slits and the inserted dielectric between the two plates can change the shielding effectiveness. This algorithm is also available for analyzing the scattering and transmission of slits with different shape, location and dielectric media filled on multiple metal plates.

articleTitle: Study on infinite objects' scattering problems
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The paper analyzes the response of power lines excited by an incident electromagnetic field. A new 2D FDTD method is proposed which analyzes the response of infinite scattering objects excited by electromagnetic waves at an oblique incidence. Maxwell's equations, differential equations and PML absorbing boundary conditions (ABC) are derived. The connecting boundary, where the incident wave is inducted, is computed by the 1D FDTD method. Several numerical calculations of this new FDTD method are provided and compared with the results of transmission line theory, proving the correctness and advantage of this new method.

articleTitle: The penetrating of repetitive UWB pulse into a rectangular cavity through slots
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The coupling effects of repetitive ultra-wideband (UWB) electromagnetic pulse into a rectangular cavity through slots are calculated by using the finite difference time domain (FDTD) method. By analyzing the energy coupling into the cavity, the coupling resonant characteristic of repetitive UWB pulse with slots is obtained. The results are useful to study the shielding performance of metallic enclosures.

articleTitle: Scattering signatures analysis using genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: A real-valued genetic algorithm is proposed as a means of extracting one-dimensional scattering centers. In terms of the extraction of scattering signatures from noise-corrupted data, the genetic algorithm has been compared to the state space approach, and the results show that this method has higher-noise immunity.

articleTitle: Study on the radio interference of 750kV supervoltage transmission lines
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Through calculating and analyzing the interference level about different parameters of 750 kV lines, this paper puts forward the control values of the 750 kV supervoltage transmission line radio interference.

articleTitle: Radio systems techniques for enhancing energy efficiency and reducing interference and parasitic radiation
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: For the third or fourth cellular generations new techniques such as those described in this paper will become dominant. These techniques will be more easy to implement for the new cellular frequency range of 1800/2000 MHz and even for higher frequencies, than for the actual dominant 900 MHz band. This is due to the smaller antenna dimensions and to fewer radiation hazards from the new higher frequency bands.

articleTitle: Joint time-frequency analysis on PD pulse signals in GIS
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Computer simulation of partial discharge pulse propagation on one bay of GIS is performed by EMTP-ATP., which provides a reference for PD detection and location. The joint time-frequency analysis method is used for the pattern recognition of partial discharge, and the recognition results are better than other methods.

articleTitle: The induced current on the cable in the IBDN caused by the lightning stroke to ground
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The magnetic field produced by a lightning stroke may induce a strong current on power line and communication cables, and this induced current can propagate into an integrated building distribution network (IBDN) or a commercial building network and cause harmful effects. The paper proposes a model based on transmission line theory. The induced currents on both the cable sheath and the core are analyzed. The precise formulations for calculating these current are given.

articleTitle: The experimental study on Bluetooth system of anti-disturbance
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Bluetooth is a short-range radio link intended to replace cables connecting portable and/or fixed electronic devices. Its main features are robustness, low complexity, low power consumption and low cost. For instance, Bluetooth can be used in the communication between mobile devices or mobile devices and static devices. In this paper, we discuss the anti-disturbance performance of the Bluetooth technology. We design the experiments with applied Bluetooth system and analysis its anti-disturbance performance.

articleTitle: Analysis for shielding effectiveness of infinite metal plate with arrayed apertures using semi-analytical FDTD
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: We compute and analyze the shielding effectiveness of the infinite perfect conductor plate with arrayed slender apertures using semi-analytical FDTD. The solution offers advice on designing an electrical equipment box with apertures.

articleTitle: The study of the electric hermetical measurements for the door's aperture
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In order to search for the optimal electric hermetical measurements for the door aperture, some techniques are presented using various shielding gasket materials. Corresponding experiments are implemented at the same time. Lots of results are obtained from those experiments, which provide an important reference for the relevant related designs.

articleTitle: Time-domain analysis method of lightning transient characteristics of grounding electrode
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: A new numerical method based on the Chebyshev equation is applied to analyze the transient characteristics of a grounding system electrode under lightning current in this paper. The time-variable parameters caused by the soil ionization effect around the grounding conductor are considered. It shows this numerical method is an effective one and the ionization effect of the grounding conductor cannot be ignored. This result is validated by comparison with the results in literature.

articleTitle: Study on two types of commercial ESD simulators
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, the performances of two types of ESD simulators (ESS-200AX made in Noiseken and NSG435 made in Schaffner) are studied, and ESD immunity experiments of a single chip microcomputer (SCM) system are made. The experimental results show that the differences between two simulators yield inconsistent test results though they both comply with the IEC61000-4-2 ESD standard. Therefore, besides the ESD current waveform, the relevant IEC61000-4-2 ESD standard should specify the discharge current derivative, related electromagnetic field in detail, and give unified specifications for the construction and configuration of ESD simulators.

articleTitle: Segmentation of SAR image in electromagnetic environment based on fractal theory
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The arithmetic of traditional segmentation and region extraction is based on extraction of shape of objects. Because of the existence of a great deal of speckle noise and fuzzy information in SAR images, it is difficult to realize the segmentation of the region. In the light of the special ability of fractal dimension in the expression of roughness of texture, region segmentation of SAR images based on fractal dimension obtains ideal results.

articleTitle: Transient analysis of electromagnetic field near the overhead conductors subjected to lightning
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The time domain performance of the electromagnetic field subjected to a lightning strike is discussed. The model is based on the quasi-static electromagnetic field theory approach and the complex image method. Once the frequency domain responses have been obtained, the time domain performance of the system is computed by an inverse Fourier transformation of all these responses. The method may be applied for frequencies up to 1 MHz, thus covering the frequency spectrum of a typical full lightning too.

articleTitle: Analysis on the observational probability of SES
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In the paper, the expressions of subaerial electric field (lower frequency) radiated by a unit electric current source underground is derived for a half-space using the method of image charges. 3D gridding plots for various direction cosines of the electric current source are presented and radiation directivity of SES and the observational probability for various direction cosines of the electric current source are also discussed.

articleTitle: Study on the HEMP induced current in the two-wire line with the metal shielded bushing
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: Lines into and out of a shielding box, such as power supply line and communication line are important ways by which coupling of electromagnetic pulsed energy interferes with and harms the circuit. In this paper, induced current in the two-wire line enclosed by a metal shielded bushing with one end exposed to HEMP is calculated by using the 3D FDTD method. The two-wire line is near the ground and the metal shielded bushing is directly grounded at both ends. The result is reasonable compared to the experimental data.

articleTitle: Numerical study of field radiated by a thin wire with ESD current injected
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, the electromagnetic field radiated by a thin wire parallel to the ground with ESD current injected is studied using the FDTD method and a numerical computation model is established. Characteristics of the radiation field and its variation rules with the distance of the wire away from the ground are analyzed.

articleTitle: Author index
publicationTitle: Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, 2003. CEEM 2003. Proceedings.
abstract: The author index contains an entry for each author and coauthor included in the proceedings record.
